closure_items_resolved.description: Secure the BFF caller boundary (HMAC-signed HttpOnly+SameSite=Strict cookie; fail-closed for untrusted network exposure)
closure_items_resolved.implementation: src/lib/auth/cookie.ts (HMAC sign/verify with constant-time compare) + src/app/api/auth/setup/route.ts (issues cookie) + BFF proxy authorize() check

closure_items_resolved.description: Bounded upstream timeout + abort propagation in BFF
closure_items_resolved.implementation: BFF proxy: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS (default 30000, bounded 1s-60s via GENESIS_BFF_TIMEOUT_MS); abortController races timeout + incoming req.signal; 504 on timeout, 503 on network failure

closure_items_resolved.description: Path decoding / allowed methods / upstream URL construction safety
closure_items_resolved.implementation: BFF proxy: isSafeSegment() rejects '.', '..', null bytes, control chars, %00, leading '/'; method whitelist (GET/POST only → 405 for others); URL() constructor (no string concat); redirect: 'error' on upstream; explicit decodeURIComponent with try/catch on malformed % sequences

closure_items_resolved.description: Remove permissive CORS unless explicitly required and securely constrained
closure_items_resolved.implementation: BFF proxy: removed OPTIONS handler entirely; removed Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * header. Same-origin only; cross-origin callers blocked by browser same-origin policy + SameSite=Strict cookie.

known_limitations: Browser auth requires server-side proxy (Next.js Route Handler BFF). Direct browser-to-gateway would leak the API key.

BFF caller boundary is a single shared HMAC cookie (smallest appropriate for controlled environment). Multi-tenant RBAC and real identity provider integration are out of scope (10_OPERATOR_DECISIONS §Exclusions). Production hardening deferred to G7-06.

BFF secret (GENESIS_BFF_SECRET) is a per-process random in dev mode; cookies do not survive restart. In production, GENESIS_BFF_SECRET must be set or /api/auth/setup refuses to issue cookies (fail-closed).
Event stream is polling-based; no SSE/WebSocket. 100-event cap per response.
Cross-caller isolation returns 404 (not 403) by design — UI cannot distinguish 'not found' from 'not yours'.
Idempotency key is in-memory only; does not survive gateway restart.

Gateway was not running during screenshot capture — UI shows honest Disconnected state (cookie issued → /health polled → 503 UNAVAILABLE). This is the correct behavior per the spec. Full 200-path verification requires starting the gateway with a controlled API key (instructions in web/README.md).
CI clean-room install (UI-026) deferred to G7-06 — sandbox prevents a clean checkout.

Path traversal attempts (.., %2e%2e) are intercepted by Next.js's path normalization (308 redirect) before reaching the BFF route handler. The BFF's isSafeSegment() defense-in-depth check also rejects them at the route handler level.
